settings.title: The TruSea Promise
settings.content:
At TruSea, we believe seafood should be as pure as the ocean it comes from. Not just “fresh-looking,” but truly fresh, safe, and honest. Our promise is simple — to bring your family seafood that is free from chemicals, free from unnecessary handling, and delivered within hours of catch.

Every fish you receive carries one commitment:
Real freshness, Real safety, Real taste.

trusea_about_story_gGeaHU.name: TruSea – Mission

settings.title: Our Mission
settings.content:
To redefine how India experiences seafood — with honesty instead of hype, freshness instead of chemicals, and care instead of convenience.

We are not just delivering fish.
We are delivering trust to your dining table.

Welcome to TruSea —
where the ocean meets your home, the right way.

trusea_mission_k8kgBG.name: TruSea – Family First

settings.title: Family-First Health
settings.content:
We started TruSea with one question:

“Would we serve this fish to our own family?”

If the answer is not a confident yes, it never reaches your plate. Formalin awareness, chemical concerns, and unsafe handling are real problems. Your children, parents, and loved ones deserve better than compromise.

TruSea exists so families can enjoy seafood without fear — only with flavor, nutrition, and peace of mind.
